description: Operator metadata of the Relay Specification v0 (draft), RELAY-v0.md section 3. Each case: the host the document was fetched from, the document (inline, or as its exact bytes in document_raw), and whether a gateway accepts it. A document is valid if it is at most 16 KiB, I-JSON, valid against relay/schema/metadata-v0.schema.json and meets the rules of Sections 3 and 6.8 beyond the schema; for the name domain, a case is invalid where the overlap with an operator host can be seen without the Public Suffix List (Section 7.1).

cases.why: enrollment on a subdomain of the operator domain
eight pins together, four of each kind
seven active pins and one backup pin
IPv6 in the form of RFC 5952: no :: for a single zero field, :: for the longest run
operator_domain is not the host the document was fetched from
operator_domain is not the host: fetched from a subdomain
name_domain below the operator domain: same registered domain (Section 7.1)
operator domain below the name domain: same registered domain (Section 7.1)
enrollment host is not on the operator domain
enrollment host only ends with the operator domain
relay host below the name domain (Section 7.1)
pin with trailing bits that are not zero: not the base64url of a digest
IPv6 not in the form of RFC 5952: zeros not compressed
IPv6 with :: for a single zero field
IPv6 with :: not on the longest run of zeros
not an IPv6 address, although the schema's pattern matches
IPv4-mapped IPv6 address: RFC 5952 asks for the mixed notation, which the schema excludes
planned IPv6 address not in the form of RFC 5952
from of planned addresses is not a date
a member the schema does not list: the document is closed
eight active pins: at most seven, so that a backup pin fits
privacy policy below the name domain (Section 3)
